match_switch_rule1: Applies to this session only — your saved default type is untouched
match_switch_rule2: Switching closes this session and redraws — the same test may appear again
match_switch_rule3: Re-arranged in the new type's ability order
match_switch_warn: {n} abilities done this session — those results stay in Records, but the session re-arranges into the {type} four-ability lineup.
match_pick_tie_head: FPS and MOBA votes are tied (or unclassified) — pick one manually.
match_pick_normal_head: Pick this session's type. It does not change your game preferences.
match_pick_empty_body: No tests are live under this type yet — try again later, or take the other type first.
match_guide_rule1_d: Backgrounding interrupts sampling and voids that run
match_guide_rule2_d: No skipping; the full {n}-game set unlocks the report
match_guide_rule3_d: Each retake spends one chance; the button grays out at zero
match_guide_rule4_d: Multiple runs of one test show the session best
match_guide_rule5_d: Progress keeps for 7 days; past that the next visit draws a fresh session
match_guide_score_d: Retake freely — the session best is shown; the all-time best is the cross-session per-ability maximum.
match_guide_keep: You can exit midway — progress keeps for 7 days
